Garage description
An experimental color first tested during the local conflict in East Africa. According to military psychologists, this specific pattern resembling a divine fire will trigger a sense of panic within enemies.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Lava was worth 1,500 crystals and could be bought from Master Corporal.
Legacy paint description:
A fiery paint that somewhat weakens the frost and damage effect of Freeze. Works well in short-range battles and makes your tank stand out more.
